title: Roanoke: One Word
idea: August 1590: John White finally returns to the English colony he left on Roanoke Island three years earlier. All of them are gone, his daughter and his granddaughter Virginia Dare too, and he lands on her third birthday. No bodies, no graves. The houses have been taken down, a tall palisade stands in their place, CRO is carved on a tree and CROATOAN on a gate post. They had agreed to carve a cross if they left in danger: there is no cross. Croatoan was a friendly island fifty miles south, but a storm takes his anchors and he never gets there. Croatoan or inland?
hook: In 1590, a man came back to his colony in America. All 115 people were gone, and one word was carved on a post.
caption:
August 1590. John White finally gets back to the colony he left on Roanoke Island three years before. Everyone is gone: around 115 people, his daughter, and his granddaughter Virginia, the first English child born in America. He lands on her third birthday. 🏮

No bodies. No graves. The houses taken down, a tall wall of posts in their place. CRO on a tree. CROATOAN on the gate post.

Before he left, they had agreed: if they moved, carve the name of the place. If they were in danger, carve a cross above it. There was no cross.

Croatoan was an island fifty miles south, home to friendly people. A storm took his anchors, and he never got there. Nobody has proven where they went.

CROATOAN or INLAND? Comment one word 👇🦊
first_comment: The word was carved in capital letters on one of the big posts at the entrance. The agreed sign of danger was a cross. Search Croatoan Island today: it is part of Hatteras. 🌊🦊
